## Adding a New Environment

Use environments to separate staging, production, and testing flag configurations.

<Step>
  <StepItem title="Create the environment via the control plane">
    Send a POST request to the environments endpoint with your project and name.

    ```bash
    curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/environments \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY"
    ```
  </StepItem>
  <StepItem title="Seed initial flags for the environment">
    Copy flag variations and rules from an existing environment or create from scratch.
  </StepItem>
  <StepItem title="Update your application">
    Initialize the SDK for the new environment using its client key.
  </StepItem>
</Step>
